name: Helck
description: Three months have passed since the Demon Lord was struck down, and the Demon Realm is holding a tournament to select his replacement. The leading contestant is Helck, a human hero who claims to hate his own kind. Some aren't happy with the idea of a human becoming the next Demon Lord—especially Vermilio the Red. She wants nothing more than to protect demonkind and prove Helck to be their enemy, even if she has to rig the competition to do it!

videos.title: Helck the Hero
videos.overview: The Demon Lord is defeated by a human hero. To find his replacement, the demonkin hold a competition. Helck, a human and mortal enemy, is among the participants.

videos.title: Anne From Management
videos.overview: Helck continues to rack up victories as a fan favorite of the crowd. He then proceeds on to the semifinal race! Will he be able to keep up with the other racers?

videos.title: The Unknown Enemy
videos.overview: Helck displays mind-blowing strength and leaves Vermilio increasingly concerned about the threat he poses.

videos.title: Shock
videos.overview: After Helck blocks an attack meant for Edil, Vermilio becomes convinced that he is an enemy. But then, the floor gives away and everyone falls into a dark underground room...

videos.title: The Remote Island Village
videos.overview: The mysterious power of the gate sends Vermilio and Helck to an unknown remote island. Vermilio travels deeper into the island and comes across a fluffy creature.

videos.title: Invasion
videos.overview: Vermilio poses a question to Helck: “Can you fight against your old friends?” Meanwhile, the others at Castle Urum are fighting an overwhelming number of winged knights.

videos.title: The Human King
videos.overview: Hyura and the others escape Castle Urum but soon find themselves surrounded again. Azudra arrives to subdue the winged knights. All the while, Azudra begins plotting.

videos.title: Back to the Continent
videos.overview: Azudra determines the winged knights are a major threat. Meanwhile, Helck and Vermilio take it easy.

videos.title: Barbarians of the Tothman Tribe
videos.overview: Helck and Vermilio bid farewell to the mysterious island and its residents as they sail away with a stowaway Piwi aboard. However, they run into a massive whirlpool!

videos.title: In Pursuit of a Map
videos.overview: Helck and company end up in the Erille Kingdom where they must fight the barbarians of the Tothman Tribe. The Tothman King goes berserk after tapping into a mysterious power.

videos.title: The Troubadour's Song
videos.overview: Helck and company use their winnings from the cooking competition to buy a map leading to the Empire. They make plans to go northwest into the ruins of two destroyed kingdoms.

videos.title: The Spirit of Faith
videos.overview: Vermilio is frightened by Helck's power as he goes berserk during his battle with Augis. It makes her recall the words of the Great Witch, who warned her about Helck.

videos.title: With Younger Brother in Tow
videos.overview: When they were little, Helck and his younger brother Cless lost both of their parents. One day, Cless gets very sick and Helck begs for someone to save him.

videos.title: The Mercenaries
videos.overview: Only half a month after Cless departs on his expedition, monsters begin to appear in greater numbers than ever before. The kingdom enacts a military draft to combat them.

videos.title: The Power of Heroes
videos.overview: Helck arrives at the Demon Lord’s castle and senses a powerful presence. It turns out to be Azudra of the Four Elite Lords, who makes a plea for peace.

videos.title: The Truth Behind Awakening
videos.overview: Zeruzeon reveals the kingdom’s terrifying plan, so Helck and his friends sneak into the castle to put a stop to it by saving Cless.

videos.title: Traitors
videos.overview: Helck is on the verge of being killed. To save the life of his big brother, Cless is forced to make a choice.

videos.title: Smile
videos.overview: Helck charges onward but an army of bounty hunters stands between him and Alicia. She is in horrible shape as she faces public execution.

videos.title: Vermilio of the Four Elite Lords
videos.overview: Helck's motivations become clear with an awakening of a horrific truth. Vermilio vows to fight by Helck’s side.

videos.title: The Mysterious Woman
videos.overview: The winged knights continue attacking Castle Thor to level themselves up further. Meanwhile, Asta keeps snooping for information in the human realm.

videos.title: Phase 2
videos.overview: Zeruzeon leads the winged knights in an assault on the newly rebuilt castle. Humans and demons become locked in combat.

videos.title: Spell Breaker
videos.overview: Hyura and Edil battle it out at Castle Thor while a strange relationship starts between them. Meanwhile, Mikaros is confronted by Azudra and reveals a past grudge.

videos.title: The Chosen Path
videos.overview: Raphaed’s army attacks a demonkin outpost, when Helck and Vermilio arrive. Raphaed determines Vermilio is Helck's newfound source of support.

videos.title: Towards a Hopeful Future
videos.overview: Helck faces off with his former friend, Alicia. Meanwhile, Vermilio can't help but be concerned about Helck as she continues to fight with Raphaed.
